Nora (People Ops): Quick Q from Ethan  he had to take a COVID PCR test for entry to Japan last week and wants to expense it. Is the company covering travel-entry health tests?
Ethan: Yep  I paid $95 for an airport PCR within 48h of departure. The airline/entry rules required it. I attached the PDF lab receipt but it doesn't say "for travel" specifically.
Priya: If the test was required by the destination or carrier for business travel, we reimburse. Need a clear date, name on receipt, and payment proof. Lab receipts are preferred.
Finance Ops: Correct. Code as travel:health-testing. Attach: (1) lab invoice or kit purchase receipt, (2) proof of requirement (screenshot of airline or government entry rule), and (3) confirmation of travel (flight itinerary or calendar invite).
Ethan: I have the lab PDF and the airline screenshot showing required PCR within 72h. Flight itinerary attached. Is the lab PDF enough if it doesn't mention "travel"?
Nora (People Ops): Yes thats fine. We only need converging evidence: receipt date matches the requirement window and employee name matches. If lab receipt lacks name but your booking shows same card/txn date, Finance can accept with a short attestation.
Health & Safety Bot: NOTE: For at-home antigen kits we require the purchase receipt (card transaction) plus a photo of the kit with the lot/barcode and the dated test result. Self-sworn attestations are accepted only when lab access was unavailable, and manager approval is required.
Priya: One nuance on kits: some countries only accept laboratory PCR results. If the destination required PCR specifically, we cannot reimburse an antigen home test. Please check the required test type in your screenshot.
Finance Ops: Also: if you used a personal card and later got reimbursed by insurance, do not double-claim. If covered by travel insurance, provide the insurer explanation or mark as reimbursed in the expense.
Ethan: Got it. Ill attach airline rule screenshot and lab PDF. Quick question: can we use FSA receipts for these?
Finance Ops: Medical FSAs may cover tests in some regions; reimbursement policy from the company is separate. We reimburse travel-required tests as business expenses. For FSA use, keep copies; consult your FSA admin.
Nora (People Ops): I'll add a short template reply for approvers: "Reimbursable: COVID PCR/required health test when mandated by destination/carrier for business travel. Attach lab invoice, travel proof (itinerary) and rule screenshot. Home-test: attach purchase receipt + dated result photo; PCR-only jurisdictions require lab PCR. Manager sign-off required if evidence is partial."
Priya: Can someone paste a one-liner we can put in the receipts wiki?
Nora (People Ops): "Company reimburses entry-mandated travel tests (PCR/authorized tests) when tied to business travel. Provide test receipt, travel itinerary, and proof of requirement. Home antigen kits accepted only where permitted; include photo of result + purchase receipt. Manager approval required for incomplete evidence."
Ethan: Thanks all  uploading now. :white_check_mark:
